harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a self-signed local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA, 10-year validity, CN=OS Comparison Root CA), installed it into the system trust store via update-ca-trust, verified it functions as a trusted CA (a leaf cert signed by it verifies against the system bundle), then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, triggered systemctl reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified the CA trust anchor and functional verification survived the restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (CentOS Stream 10) and confirmed openssl/update-ca-trust availability
Generated 4096-bit RSA CA key and self-signed root certificate CN=OS Comparison Root CA with CA:TRUE basicConstraints
Copied CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified CA appears as trust anchor via `trust list` and in consolidated ca-bundle.crt
Generated a test leaf cert signed by the new CA and verified it with openssl verify using system trust
Captured pre-restart boot_id and system health baseline
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until reachable, confirming new boot_id (proving actual restart)
Re-verified post-restart: system running, CA trust anchor present, leaf cert still verifies against system bundle

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created
evidence.summary: openssl generated 4096-bit key and self-signed cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison Lab, valid 2026-2036

evidence.requirement: CA installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Cert copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, update-ca-trust extract run, trust list shows it as an anchor; a leaf cert signed by the CA verifies via system trust with no explicit CAfile
Captured boot_id 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e, systemctl is-system-running=running, CA anchor present
Backgrounded systemctl reboot via nohup/disown; command returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately
Connection timed out then reset while node was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves actual restart
evidence.summary: Node reachable again with new boot_id 2655d3c4-9b28-4915-a060-2b55912db03c and uptime=5s, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust and service health
evidence.summary: system running, trust list still shows OS Comparison Root CA anchor, ca-bundle.crt still contains it, and leaf cert re-verifies against system bundle
